router_mechanism.question: what limits qwen35_router_logits_f32_token_tile_dense_exact_kernel<4>
findings: the faithful T=4 copy is bit-identical to the shipped library, so the screen is attributable
token tile width is not the lever: T=8 1.11x, T=16 1.04x, T=32 0.75x
traffic is not the lever: the shipped kernel sustains 2222 GB/s of L2-resident re-reads, and a 2D LDS tile with 10x less traffic is 3.9x slower
the lever is the reduction structure: replacing the 8-barrier 256-thread LDS tree with a 32-lane shuffle is 2.03x
router_mechanism.arithmetic_status: the warp variant is NOT bit-exact (max abs diff 4.9e-7) because the reduction order changes, so it needs the production profile gate, not a parity argument
